title: Luba-Katanga language - Wikipedia
text: Luba-Katanga, also known as Luba-Shaba and Kiluba (Luba-Katanga: Kiluba), is a Bantu language (Zone L) of Central Africa. It is spoken mostly in the south-east area of the Democratic Republic of the Congo by the Luba people.

title: Luba-Katanga language — Grokipedia
text: Luba-Katanga, also known as Kiluba or Luba-Shaba, is a Bantu language belonging to the Niger-Congo family, spoken by approximately 1.5 million people (as of 2023) primarily in the southeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
